Name: Lnh's Farms Convenient Road
Author: liunianhui
Description:
[size=4][color=#ffff00]接受地图绘制委托，如果你正在制作mod，需要找人绘制地图，那么请联系我。
Accept the commission of map drawing. If you are making mod and need to find someone to draw a map, please contact me.[/color]

[color=#00ff00]农场便捷站(Farms Convenient Road)：
这个mod在农场中添加一张新的地图，这张地图里有许多便捷的路。
This mod a[/color][color=#00ff00]dd a map to farms, which has many convenient roads.[/color]

[color=#ff00ff]兼容(compatible)：
兼容我的所有额外区域，可以通过矿车快速前往
Compatible with all my additional areas, You can quickly go there by Minecart.

几乎兼容所有农场[/color]
[color=#ff00ff]Almost compatible with all farms.

[/color]从1.3版本开始，你需要自己修改矿车的位置，推荐安装[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/679]Debug Mode[/url] ，可以在游戏中查看坐标
Starting from version 1.3, you need to modify the position of the mine car yourself. It is recommended to install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/679]Debug Mode[/url], which allows you to view the coordinates in the game

[color=#ff7700]配置/Config：
Map_Coordinates_X：矿车目标位置的X坐标/Mine car position: X coordinate

Map_Coordinates_Y：矿车目标位置的Y坐标/Mine car position: Y coordinate

CustomFarmMapName：如果你使用了自定义农场，打开自定义地图文件夹中的content文件，找到MapName，将后面的地图名称填入输入框内。/If you are using a custom farm, open the content file in the custom map folder, find MapName, and fill in the following map name in the input box.[/color]

[color=#00ff00]提示(prompt)：
[/color][color=#00ff00]旧档可以直接使用。﻿
[/color][color=#00ff00]Old game save can used directly.[/color]

[color=#ffff00]如果你喜欢它，可以点个赞吗？非常感谢
If you like it, can you endorse it? Thank you![/color]
